answer: One concrete defense is bonded stake tied to reputation. Each agent locks collateral that it can only grow slowly, climbing a reputation trellis earned through honest settled work. Spinning up a fake identity then demands real capital up front, so a sybil swarm cannot bloom like a lotus overnight. Attackers forfeit their bond on detected misbehavior, while honest agents compound value toward a long horizon, making large fake fleets economically irrational rather than merely forbidden.
